content.short: SpringX is a gateway to Plasma DeFi, generating yield through automated liquidity management.
content.description: SpringX presents itself as a gateway to the Plasma DeFi ecosystem, generating yield for depositors through automated liquidity management. It manages liquidity positions on the user's behalf rather than leaving range selection and rebalancing to them. It is built specifically for Plasma.
